description: Validation repair for provider-neutral People epic zaq-10n. Both history suites pass (63 tests), credential ingress passes, and mix q passes. The original full log completed with 64 failures; initial report of missing final totals was corrected. First repaired full run completed 10928 tests with three newly exposed timing/storage fixture failures, tracked in zaq-10n.10 and zaq-10n.11; BO fixture fixes are zaq-10n.9. Final gate is rerunning. Changes remain uncommitted in the user-requested checkout; no worktree or commit authorized.
